title: षष्ठोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 6 · At the gate of the camp

summary.en: Ashvatthaman stands at the camp gate, and a huge being guards it, so that Ashvatthaman's weapons are useless against him. Seeing this, he resolves to seek refuge in Shiva himself.
summary.kn: ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ ಶಿಬಿರದ ದ್ವಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಾಗ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮಹಾಕಾಯ ಜೀವಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದು ಅವನ ಆಯುಧಗಳು ನಿಷ್ಪ್ರಯೋಜಕವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಅವನು ಶಿವನಲ್ಲೇ ಶರಣಾಗಲು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अश्वत्थामा शिविर के द्वार पर खड़ा होता है और वहाँ एक विशाल प्राणी पहरा देता है जिस पर उसके शस्त्र निष्फल होते हैं। यह देखकर वह स्वयं शिव की शरण लेने का निश्चय करता है।
summary.te: అశ్వత్థామ శిబిర ద్వారం వద్ద నిలవగా ఒక మహా కాయ ప్రాణి కాపలా ఉండి అతని ఆయుధాలు నిష్ఫలమవుతాయి. ఇది చూసి శివుని శరణు పొందాలని నిశ్చయిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: அஸ்வத்தாமன் பாசறை வாயிலில் நிற்க, ஒரு பெரிய உயிர் காவல் நிற்கிறது; அவனது ஆயுதங்கள் அதன்மேல் பயனற்றுப் போகின்றன. இதைக் கண்டு அவன் சிவனையே சரணடைய முடிவுசெய்கிறான்.
summary.ml: പാളയത്തിന്റെ കവാടത്തിൽ അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ് നിൽക്കുന്നു; ഒരു ഭീമാകാരനായ ജീവി കാവൽ നിൽക്കുന്നതിനാൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ആയുധങ്ങൾ അവനെതിരെ ഫലിക്കുന്നില്ല. ഇതു കണ്ട അദ്ദേഹം ശിവനെത്തന്നെ അഭയം തേടാൻ തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 10.6; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Fri Oct 30 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
द्वारदेशे ततो द्रौणिमवस्थितमवेक्ष्य तौ ।
अकुर्वतां भोजकृपौ किं संजय वदस्व मे ॥

meaning.en: When Bhoja and Kripa saw the son of Drona standing at the gate, what did they do, Sanjaya? Tell me.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
कृतवर्माणमामन्त्र्य कृपं च स महारथम् ।
द्रौणिर्मन्युपरीतात्मा शिबिरद्वारमासदत् ॥

meaning.en: Taking leave of Kritavarman and the great charioteer Kripa, Drona's son, his heart filled with fury, came to the gate of the camp.

verses.text:
तत्र भूतं महाकायं चन्द्रार्कसदृशद्युतिम् ।
सोऽपश्यद्द्वारमावृत्य तिष्ठन्तं लोमहर्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: There he saw a huge, hair-raising being, radiant as the moon and sun, standing and blocking the gate.

verses.text:
वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं महारुधिरविस्रवम् ।
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥

meaning.en: It was clad in a tiger's hide streaming with blood, wore a black antelope skin as a shawl, and had a snake for its sacred thread.

verses.text:
बाहुभिः स्वायतैः पीनैर्नानाप्रहरणोद्यतैः ।
बद्धाङ्गदमहासर्पं ज्वालामालाकुलाननम् ॥

meaning.en: It had long, thick arms raised with many weapons, great serpents bound as armlets, and a face wreathed in garlands of flame.

verses.text:
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनं व्यादितास्यं भयावहम् ।
नयनानां सहस्रैश्च विचित्रैरभिभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Its mouth was fearsome with fangs and gaping wide, terrifying, and it was adorned with thousands of strange eyes.

verses.text:
नैव तस्य वपुः शक्यं प्रवक्तुं वेष एव वा ।
सर्वथा तु तदालक्ष्य स्फुटेयुरपि पर्वताः ॥

meaning.en: Its form or even its dress cannot be described; seeing it fully, even mountains would split.

verses.text:
तस्यास्यान्नासिकाभ्यां च श्रवणाभ्यां च सर्वशः ।
तेभ्यश्चाक्षिसहस्रेभ्यः प्रादुरासन्महार्चिषः ॥

meaning.en: From its mouth, nostrils, ears and all over, and from those thousands of eyes, great flames burst forth.

verses.text:
तथा तेजोमरीचिभ्यः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः ।
प्रादुरासन्हृषीकेशाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: And from the rays of its radiance there appeared by hundreds and thousands forms of Hrishikesha bearing conch, discus and mace.

verses.text:
तदत्यद्भुतमालोक्य भूतं लोकभयंकरम् ।
द्रौणिरव्यथितो दिव्यैरस्त्रवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that most marvelous being, a terror to the world, the son of Drona, unshaken, showered it with divine weapons.

verses.text:
द्रौणिमुक्ताञ्शरांस्तांस्तु तद्भूतं महदग्रसत् ।
उदधेरिव वार्योघान्पावको वडवामुखः ॥

meaning.en: That great being swallowed the arrows shot by Drona's son, as the submarine fire swallows floods of water from the ocean.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा तु संप्रेक्ष्य ताञ्शरौघान्निरर्थकान् ।
रथशक्तिं मुमोचास्मै दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthaman, seeing his flood of arrows wasted, hurled at it a chariot spear, blazing like a tongue of fire.

verses.text:
सा तदाहत्य दीप्ताग्रा रथशक्तिरशीर्यत ।
युगान्ते सूर्यमाहत्य महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता ॥

meaning.en: That spear, its tip glowing, struck it and shattered, like a great meteor falling from the sky upon the sun at the end of the age.

verses.text:
अथ हेमत्सरुं दिव्यं खड्गमाकाशवर्चसम् ।
कोशात्समुद्बबर्हाशु बिलाद्दीप्तमिवोरगम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he swiftly drew from its sheath a divine sword with a golden hilt, bright as the sky, like a blazing serpent from a hole.

verses.text:
ततः खड्गवरं धीमान्भूताय प्राहिणोत्तदा ।
स तदासाद्य भूतं वै विलयं तूलवद्ययौ ॥

meaning.en: The wise man then hurled that excellent sword at the being; reaching it, the sword vanished like cotton.

verses.text:
ततः स कुपितो द्रौणिरिन्द्रकेतुनिभां गदाम् ।
ज्वलन्तीं प्राहिणोत्तस्मै भूतं तामपि चाग्रसत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son, enraged, threw at it a blazing mace like the banner of Indra, and the being swallowed that too.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वायुधाभावे वीक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः ।
अपश्यत्कृतमाकाशमनाकाशं जनार्दनैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with no weapon left, looking this way and that, he saw the sky filled with Janardanas, so that there was no empty sky.

verses.text:
तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रो निरायुधः ।
अब्रवीदभिसंतप्तः कृपवाक्यमनुस्मरन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that most marvelous sight, the son of Drona, weaponless and sorely troubled, remembered Kripa's words and spoke.

verses.text:
ब्रुवतामप्रियं पथ्यं सुहृदां न शृणोति यः ।
स शोचत्यापदं प्राप्य यथाहमतिवर्त्य तौ ॥

meaning.en: A man who does not heed the unwelcome but wholesome words of friends grieves on meeting calamity, as I do, having disregarded those two.

verses.text:
शास्त्रदृष्टानवध्यान्यः समतीत्य जिघांसति ।
स पथः प्रच्युतो धर्म्यात्कुपथं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: One who, overstepping what the scriptures show, wishes to kill those not to be killed, falls from the path of dharma and enters a bad road.

verses.text:
गोब्राह्मणनृपस्त्रीषु सख्युर्मातुर्गुरोस्तथा ।
वृद्धबालजडान्धेषु सुप्तभीतोत्थितेषु च ॥

meaning.en: Against cows, brahmins, kings, women, a friend, a mother, a teacher, the old, children, the dull and the blind, the sleeping, the frightened, those just risen,

verses.text:
मत्तोन्मत्तप्रमत्तेषु न शस्त्राण्युपधारयेत् ।
इत्येवं गुरुभिः पूर्वमुपदिष्टं नृणां सदा ॥

meaning.en: the drunk, the mad, and the heedless, one should not take up weapons; this is what elders have always taught men.

verses.text:
सोऽहमुत्क्रम्य पन्थानं शास्त्रदृष्टं सनातनम् ।
अमार्गेणैवमारभ्य घोरामापदमागतः ॥

meaning.en: I, having left the eternal path shown by the scriptures and begun on a wrong course, have come to this dreadful calamity.

verses.text:
तां चापदं घोरतरां प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ।
यदुद्यम्य महत्कृत्यं भयादपि निवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: And the wise say that calamity is the worse one, in which a man, after undertaking a great task, turns back through fear.

verses.text:
अशक्यं चैव कः कर्तुं शक्तः शक्तिबलादिह ।
न हि दैवाद्गरीयो वै मानुषं कर्म कथ्यते ॥

meaning.en: Who here can do the impossible by sheer might? Human action is not said to outweigh fate.

verses.text:
मानुषं कुर्वतः कर्म यदि दैवान्न सिध्यति ।
स पथः प्रच्युतो धर्म्याद्विपदं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: If a man doing a human work does not succeed because of fate, he is one who has strayed from the righteous road and meets disaster.

verses.text:
प्रतिघातं ह्यविज्ञातं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ।
यदारभ्य क्रियां कांचिद्भयादिह निवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: The wise call it unforeseen frustration when a man, having begun some undertaking, turns back from it in fear.

verses.text:
तदिदं दुष्प्रणीतेन भयं मां समुपस्थितम् ।
न हि द्रोणसुतः संख्ये निवर्तेत कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: This fear has come upon me from a badly planned scheme; yet the son of Drona must never turn back from battle in any case.

verses.text:
इदं च सुमहद्भूतं दैवदण्डमिवोद्यतम् ।
न चैतदभिजानामि चिन्तयन्नपि सर्वथा ॥

meaning.en: And this huge being stands ready like the rod of fate; and though I think it over, I cannot recognize it at all.

verses.text:
ध्रुवं येयमधर्मे मे प्रवृत्ता कलुषा मतिः ।
तस्याः फलमिदं घोरं प्रतिघाताय दृश्यते ॥

meaning.en: Surely this impure resolve of mine that turned to unrighteousness has this dreadful fruit, and it appears as my frustration.

verses.text:
तदिदं दैवविहितं मम संख्ये निवर्तनम् ।
नान्यत्र दैवादुद्यन्तुमिह शक्यं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: So this turning back in battle has been ordained by fate; apart from fate nothing here could stop me in any way.

verses.text:
सोऽहमद्य महादेवं प्रपद्ये शरणं प्रभुम् ।
दैवदण्डमिमं घोरं स हि मे नाशयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: So today I take refuge in the great god Mahadeva, the lord; he will destroy this terrible rod of fate for me.

verses.text:
कपर्दिनं प्रपद्याथ देवदेवमुमापतिम् ।
कपालमालिनं रुद्रं भगनेत्रहरं हरम् ॥

meaning.en: I go for refuge to the matted-haired one, god of gods, lord of Uma, Rudra with his garland of skulls, Hara, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga.

verses.text:
स हि देवोऽत्यगाद्देवांस्तपसा विक्रमेण च ।
तस्माच्छरणमभ्येष्ये गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम् ॥

meaning.en: That god surpassed the gods by his austerity and valor; therefore I will seek refuge in Girisha, the trident-bearer.
